notes.title: RETROSURGE Release!
notes.notes:
[h1]RETROSURGE released[/h1]

Hi everyone! Today marks the first day of RETROSURGE being released! The initial update 
V .92 includes
-full arcade mode
-2 unlockable characters 
-4 arenas
-discovered stats for enemies killed
-unlockable upgrades
-difficulties to unlock


In the next few weeks I plan to make bug fixes as bugs arise and a few content updates!!

[h1]Roadmap[/h1]

Next month(august) -
-2 new characters
-new enemy types
-achievements

September-
-more characters
-more game modes
